Extract Multiple Biophysical and Environmental Indicators

Source: R/extract_indicators.R
d4h_extract_indicators.Rd

Simultaneously computes, extracts, and summarizes multiple biophysical, vegetation, water, and terrain indicators across drone orthomosaics, operational surveillance grids, and physical features. Always provides both a spatial representation ($sf) with polygons and a clean tabular data frame ($df) without geometry, including micro-environmental land cover composition (pct_bare_soil, pct_houses, pct_water, pct_vegetation, dominant_class, surveillance_priority).

Usage

d4h_extract_indicators(
  raster = NULL,
  bands = c("ndvi", "ndwi"),
  grid = NULL,
  cell_size = NULL,
  area_m2 = NULL,
  n_cells = NULL,
  square = FALSE,
  nir = NULL,
  red = NULL,
  green = NULL,
  blue = NULL,
  red_edge = NULL,
  dem = NULL,
  lst = NULL,
  water = NULL,
  buildings = NULL,
  houses = NULL,
  stat = "mean",
  scale = 1,
  quiet = FALSE,
  orthomosaic = NULL,
  aoi = NULL,
  region = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

raster

Optional SpatRaster, character path to orthomosaic, or spatial grid.

bands

Character vector. Indicators to compute and extract (default: c("ndvi", "ndwi")). Supported codes include:

  • "ndvi": Normalized Difference Vegetation Index \(\frac{\text{NIR} - \text{Red}}{\text{NIR} + \text{Red}}\)

  • "ndwi": Normalized Difference Water Index \(\frac{\text{Green} - \text{NIR}}{\text{Green} + \text{NIR}}\)

  • "gndvi": Green Normalized Difference Vegetation Index \(\frac{\text{NIR} - \text{Green}}{\text{NIR} + \text{Green}}\)

  • "savi": Soil-Adjusted Vegetation Index

  • "dvi": Difference Vegetation Index \(\text{NIR} - \text{Red}\)

  • "msavi2": Modified Soil-Adjusted Vegetation Index 2

  • "vari": Visible Atmospherically Resistant Index (RGB)

  • "ndre": Normalized Difference Red Edge

  • "evi": Enhanced Vegetation Index

  • "imsr": Micro-Surface Roughness / Debris Exposure Index

  • "slope": Terrain slope in degrees (requires dem)

  • "twi": Topographic Wetness Index (requires dem)

grid

Optional spatial grid (sf, SpatVector, or file path). If NULL, an operational grid is automatically generated across the flight footprint.

cell_size

Numeric (optional). Grid cell size / diameter in meters (default: 50 if all sizing options are NULL and grid is NULL).

area_m2

Numeric (optional). Target cell area in square meters.

n_cells

Numeric / Integer (optional). Desired total number of grid units.

square

Logical. If TRUE, square grid cells; if FALSE, regular hexagonal cells (default: FALSE).

nir

SpatRaster or character path. Near-Infrared band.

red

SpatRaster or character path. Red band.

green

SpatRaster or character path. Green band.

blue

SpatRaster or character path. Blue band.

red_edge

SpatRaster or character path. Red Edge band.

dem

SpatRaster or character path. Digital Elevation / Surface Model.

lst

SpatRaster or character path. Land Surface Temperature raster.

water

SpatVector, sf, or SpatRaster (optional). Water body features or binary water mask. If NULL and NDWI is computed, water pixels (\(\text{NDWI} > 0\)) are automatically identified.

buildings

SpatVector, sf, or SpatRaster (optional). Building / dwelling footprints or binary roof mask.

houses

Deprecated alias for buildings.

stat

Character. Summary statistic per grid unit. One of "mean" (default), "median", "min", "max", "sd".

scale

Named numeric vector or numeric value. Optional multiplier scale factor applied to indicator values (default: 1).

quiet

Logical. If TRUE, suppresses console progress messages (default: FALSE).

orthomosaic

Alias for raster.

aoi

Alias for raster.

region

Alias for raster or grid.

...

Additional arguments passed to internal functions.

Value

An object of class d4h_indicators_summary and d4h_grid_summary containing:

  • $sf: Spatial sf polygons with geometry, indicator statistics, and land cover composition.

  • $df: Tabular pure data.frame without geometry, containing all zonal metrics and land cover percentages (pct_bare_soil, pct_houses, pct_water, pct_vegetation, dominant_class, surveillance_priority).

Details

Provides a flexible, unified pipeline for automated batch extraction of biophysical indices. The function operates directly on drone orthomosaics or multispectral bands without requiring a manual region input. If an operational grid is not provided via grid, an operative surveillance grid is automatically generated across the valid flight footprint using cell_size (default: 50 m), area_m2, or n_cells.

Examples

# \donttest{
if (interactive()) {
  library(drones4health)
  library(terra)

  # Define bands
  path_nir <- system.file("extdata", "nir.tif", package = "drones4health")
  path_r   <- system.file("extdata", "red.tif", package = "drones4health")
  path_g   <- system.file("extdata", "green.tif", package = "drones4health")

  # Extract multiple indicators directly without requiring a manual region
  res <- d4h_extract_indicators(
    bands     = c("ndvi", "ndwi"),
    nir       = path_nir,
    red       = path_r,
    green     = path_g,
    cell_size = 50
  )

  # Access both the clean tabular data frame and spatial sf
  head(res$df)
  plot(res$sf)
}
# }
